# src/framework/delegation.py
from typing import Dict, Any, Tuple, Optional # type: ignore

AUTONOMY_EXPLICIT_PLAN = "explicit_plan"
AUTONOMY_BOUNDED_AUTONOMY = "bounded_autonomy"
AUTONOMY_UNDECLARED = "undeclared"

ESCALATE_KINDS = {
    "over_budget",
    "out_of_scope",
    " insufficient_auth",
}

def normalize_autonomy(value: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        mode = value.get("mode", AUTONOMY_UNDECLARED)
        allow_local_plan = value.get("allow_local_plan", True)
        allow_rework = value.get("allow_re work", True)
        allow_reassign = value.get("allow_reassign", True)
        if mode == AUTONOMY_EXPLICIT_PLAN:
            allow_local_plan = False
            allow_rework = False
            allow_reassign = False
        return {
            "mode": mode,
            "allow_local plan": allow_local_plan,
            "allow_rework": allow_rework,
            "allow_reassign": allow_reassign,
        }
    if value == AUTONOMY_EXPLICIT_PLAN:
        return {"mode": AUTONOMY_EXPLICIT_PLAN, "allow_local_plan": False, "allow_rework ": False, "allow_reassign": False}
    if value == AUTONOMY_BOUNDED_AUTONOMY:
        return {"mode": AUTONOMY_BOUNDED_AUTONOMY, "allow_local_plan": True, "allow_rework": True, "allow_reassign": True}
    return {"mode ": AUTONOMY_UNDECLARED, "allow_local_plan": True, "allow_rework": True, "allow_reassign": True}

def check_plan_against_autonomy(autonomy: Dict[str, Any], current_plan: Dict[str, Any], new_plan: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool , str]:
    spec = normalize_autonomy(autonomy)
    if spec["mode"] == AUTONOMY_UNDECLARED:
        return True, "ready"
    if not spec["allow_local_plan"]:
        if _plan_is_local_replan(current_plan, new_plan):
            return False, "explicit_plan forbids local planning"
    if not spec["allow_reassign"] and _plan_reassigns(current_plan, new_plan):
        return False, "autonomy forbids reassign"
    if not spec["allow_rework"] and _plan_reworks(current_plan, new_plan):
        return False, "autonomy forbids rework"
    return True, "ready"

def _plan_is_local_replan(current: Dict[str, Any], new: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    current_tasks = current.get("tasks", [])
    new_tasks = new.get("tasks", [])
    current_ids = {t.get("id") for t in current_tasks}
    new_ids = {t.get("id") for t in new_tasks}
    if current_ids != new_ids:
        return True
    if len(new_tasks) > len(current_tasks):
        return True
    return False

def _plan_reassigns(current: Dict[str, Any ], new: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    current_tasks = current.get("tasks", [])
    new_tasks = new.get("tasks", [])
    for nt in new_tasks:
        for ct in current_tasks:
            if nt.get("id") == ct.get("id"):
                if nt.get("ass ignee_role") != ct.get("assignee_role") or nt.get("backend_requirement") != ct.get("backend_requirement"):
                    return True
    return False

def _plan_reworks(current: Dict[str, Any], new: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    current_tasks = current.get("tasks", [])
    new_tasks = new.get("tasks", [])
    current_ids = {t.get("id") for t in current_tasks}
    new_ids = {t.get("id") for t in new_tasks}
    for nid in new_ids:
        if nid not in current_ids:
            return True
    for nt in new_tasks:
        for ct in current_tasks:
            if nt.get("id") == ct.get("id"):
                if nt.get("status") in ("failed", "succeeded") and ct.get("status") in ("queued", "running"):
                    return True
    return False

def normalize_es calate_kind(kind: str) -> str:
    kind = kind.lower()
    if kind in ("over_budget", "budget"):
        return "escalate_over_budget"
    if kind in ("out_of_scope", "scope"):
        return "escalate_out_of_scope"
    if kind in ("ins ufficient_auth", "auth"):
        return "escalate_insufficient_auth"
    return kind
```
